tree.heading: Review
tree.text: Upon receipt of any representation made under section 2552 of this title, the Trade Representative shall review the issues concerned in consultation with—

children.text: the agency or person alleged to be engaging in violations under the Agreement;
the member agencies of the interagency trade organization established under section 1872(a) of this title;
appropriate representatives referred to in section 2547 of this title.

tree.heading: Resolution
tree.text: The Trade Representative shall undertake to resolve, on a mutually satisfactory basis, the issues set forth in the representation through consultation with the parties concerned.

notes.text: Amendments1996—Pub. L. 104–295 amended directory language of Pub. L. 103–182. See 1993 Amendment note below. 1993—Pub. L. 103–182, as amended by Pub. L. 104–295, substituted “Trade Representative” for “Special Representative” wherever appearing.
